decisions.reason: The optical spectrum service runs on the firm's owned fibre and was promoted to the home page in 2019, so it is a visible, heavily invested product that fits the announced high-bandwidth direction, and management will stay committed to it.

The number ordering portal was low-cost and has been mentioned steadily as support for the established voice business, so with sunk platform investment and no clear failure signal, management will keep it despite the weaker strategic fit of legacy voice.
